title: shabbat_controller
description: Shabbat clock: switches the relay (switch:0) on during your timers inside Shabbat & Yom Tov windows, for any place (Israel or abroad). Install, enable Run on startup and Start. Also install shabbat_ui (settings page), then open http://<shelly-ip>/script/<id>/ui and set your location: until then the relay is not switched.

title: shabbat_ui
description: Settings page for shabbat_controller (Hebrew / English). Keep the name shabbat_ui. Do NOT start it and do not enable Run on startup: it only stores the page code that the controller serves.
